mechanism: Metronidazole inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, impairing folic acid metabolism and reducing folate-dependent nucleotide synthesis, potentially leading to megaloblastic anemia and immunosuppression during prolonged therapy.
action: Monitor for signs of folate deficiency during extended metronidazole courses; consider folic acid supplementation (5mg daily) if treatment exceeds 2 weeks or in patients with existing folate depletion.
